title: Employ only licensed casino staff
what: Have prescribed casino functions done only by holders of a casino employee licence for the function.

sources.title: Casino Control Act 2006 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 41(1) (current republication (R22, from 16 November 2025; Casino Control Act 2006 | Acts))
sources.quote: The casino licensee commits an offence if, on a day— (a) a person performs a prescribed function in relation to the casino; and (b) the person either— (i) does not hold a casino employee licence to perform the function
